title: Singapore: Air quality in Singapore reaches unhealthy range for the first time in 3 years, with 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index reading showing 123 in the central region by 10 pm.
summary: Air quality in Singapore reaches unhealthy range for the first time in 3 years, with 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index reading showing 123 in the central region by 10 pm. From Wikipedia's article "2026 in Singapore" (CC BY-SA 4.0).

title: Singapore: Prime Minister Wong announces a salary hike for political officeholders, as well as Members of Parliament, Non-constituency Members of Parliament and Nominated Members of Parliament to allow salaries to keep up with market levels, the first in 15 years.
summary: Prime Minister Wong announces a salary hike for political officeholders, as well as Members of Parliament, Non-constituency Members of Parliament and Nominated Members of Parliament to allow salaries to keep up with market levels, the first in 15 years. These increments will take effect from 15 October. From Wikipedia's article "2026 in Singapore" (CC BY-SA 4.0).
